result:
`validateApp` now throws when `owner` is missing or empty. Billing and the core shell pass their owners, and the epic is closed. It all shipped in PR #1 on `mono`. CI and CD both succeeded, and all three child tickets are marked done.

- **Owners passed:** billing passes `payments` and the core shell passes `platform`, both taken from `team` in each app's `package.json`.
- **Version:** I bumped `libs/shared-contracts` to 2.0.0 because the change is breaking.
- **One PR instead of three:** `libs/shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and is inlined into each app at build time. If the library change had merged on its own, the apps would have failed to build on `main`. So I put everything in one PR.
- **No dependency update:** the "adopt the new release" step in the tickets doesn't apply, since there is no registry package to update. Billing and the core shell have no dependency on `@mfe/shared-contracts`.
- **Reports app:** the reports app also calls `validateApp` but has no ticket, and it would have broken. I made it pass `insights` (its `team`). CD only deploys the shell and billing, so this change isn't live anywhere.
- **Checks:** I built all three apps locally before opening the PR. CD isn't actually deploying (docs say deploys are off), but `st deploy wait` reported success, so that's what I went by.
